title: Build gold_supply_risk — dual HHI, contrast_ratio and is_bottleneck
description: Compute HHI_WGI,t = Σ_c (Sᶜ)² · WGIᶜ · tᶜ over each supply mix and write gold_supply_risk at grain material × stage × year, with the contrast ratio and bottleneck flag per spec.
acceptanceCriteria: gold_supply_risk grain is one row per material × stage × year — enforced, with a duplicate check that fails loudly.

hhi_global and hhi_eu_sourcing are each computed as Σ_c (Sᶜ)² · WGIᶜ · tᶜ over their respective supply_mix. Shares are used as fractions, not percentages — a test pins this, since share_pct is stored 0-100 and squaring the wrong scale is silent.
contrast_ratio = hhi_eu_sourcing / hhi_global, and is NULL (never 0) when hhi_global = 0.
is_bottleneck marks the stage with the higher hhi_global per material × year, driven by hhi_global and not by the EU index or the max of the two.
EU coverage gaps yield hhi_eu_sourcing = NULL and contrast_ratio = NULL, never 0 — a test covers a material present in global supply but absent from EU sourcing.
src/ mirror and parity tests extended to cover the HHI computation, the null rules and the bottleneck flag.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-29 by /breakdown task-038 (parent difficulty 7). Seams follow the parent's proposed breakdown, re-cut against the spec as amended 2026-07-29 (§ Business Logic & Calculations → Supply Risk, and § Data Architecture → fact_supply_share). Parent ACs were written 2026-07-19 and predate that amendment — the criteria below supersede them where they differ.
SEAM (d). Every numeric rule here traces to spec § Business Logic & Calculations → Supply Risk as amended 2026-07-29.
The parent's AC4 said grain was 'material x stage' and named only 'their contrast'. The spec now specifies material × stage × YEAR plus contrast_ratio and is_bottleneck — these criteria supersede it.

The parent's AC5 asked the implementer to CHOOSE and document the WGI vintage/aggregation. That is now decided in spec (mean of six, latest year per country, fixed-bound clamp) — task-038_3 implements it and this task consumes it. Do not re-open the decision.

DEC-002 PARITY OBLIGATION: src/transformations is the reference implementation guarded by parity tests (tests/ loads the notebook's own functions via load_notebook_functions and pins them against the src/ version). Changing notebook logic without the mirror fails CI by design. The parent task's files_affected omitted src/ and tests/ entirely — that omission is corrected in these subtasks.

LOCAL TEST SETUP: build the SparkSession with .config('spark.sql.ansi.enabled','false') — local pyspark 4.0.1 defaults ANSI on, Fabric defaults it off, and cast semantics diverge in the dangerous direction (local raises where Fabric silently nulls). See root CLAUDE.md § Gotchas.

[IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-01] implementation_status: completed. Built gold_supply_risk at grain material × stage × year (hhi_global, hhi_eu_sourcing, contrast_ratio, is_bottleneck, incomplete_wgi_coverage). Added supply_risk_contribution + compute_gold_supply_risk to BOTH src/transformations/supply_risk.py and fabric/silver-to-gold2.Notebook/notebook-content.py; notebook writes via existing write_tbl, preceded by a grain-uniqueness guard (fails loudly) + a per-run WGI-coverage/bottleneck summary print. NULL rules: NULL wgi_weight rows EXCLUDED from Σ (never coerced to 0; F.greatest/F.least swallow NULLs — guarded); placeholder countries excluded; EU coverage gap → hhi_eu_sourcing=NULL, contrast_ratio=NULL never 0; hhi_global=0 → contrast_ratio=NULL never 0. Taiwan/NULL-WGI per user decision: HHI over governance-known subset (understates Taiwan-heavy materials — accepted, visible via incomplete_wgi_coverage flag). is_bottleneck driven by hhi_global ONLY, strict (ties flag neither, NULL never wins), implemented Window-less so the parity harness (FunctionDefs in a namespace holding only F) needs no extra imports. 235 tests pass (37 in test_supply_risk.py). FR-041 logged: spec § Data Architecture L731 gold_supply_risk column list omits incomplete_wgi_coverage — routes via /iterate. files_affected widened 3→4 (+gold_tables.md, FR-037 precedent).
